title: fix(runtime)!: the publish-drafts door refuses a non-string change note 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming message (#28452)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XAZVBCz7kire8DBAJx1hUc4)_

Fixes #28452

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — a body whose `message` is not a string (a number, an object, an array, `null`), which `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts` answered 200 with the default note, is refused 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` before anything is published. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/**` or `content/docs` describes what the door does with a non-string note; the generated reference (`content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`) already declares `message` a string from the schema's `describe`, which does not move.

**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing at the publish-drafts door (`@objectstack/runtime`).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：「整包发布草稿」接口（`POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts`）现在用规范里已声明的 `PublishPackageDraftsRequestSchema` 的 `message` 成员校验变更说明；不是字符串（数字、对象、数组、null）时直接 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` 拒收并点名 `message`，什么都不发布。另翻转 #28447 留下的「已知分歧」测试针、路由台账那行的说明和 spec 注释。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28452（分诊 6547072197）：以前非字符串的说明被悄悄丢掉，发布照常进行、每条历史记录写默认说明，调用方根本不知道自己的说明被忽略了。
- **风险与回滚**：只收窄这一种请求体；字符串说明（包括空串）、不带说明、带旧 SDK 的 `actor` 都照旧 200；坏的 `backfill` 仍由协议层拒一次，答复与以前完全一样。仓内没有任何调用方发送非字符串说明（SDK 与 UI 只在给了字符串时才带 `message`）。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`（publish-drafts 分支里新加的 `declaredMessage` 校验与转发行）；`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-publish-drafts-change-note.integration.test.ts`（真实 SQLite 上的新用例）；`.changeset/28452-publish-drafts-message-refused.md`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-publish-drafts-change-note.integration.test.ts src/domains/packages-publish-drafts-request-conformance.test.ts` → 13/13 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（收窄需先过合约评审）。

## What changes

**The door** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, the `publish-drafts` branch). After the 404 for an unknown package and before the publish, the door parses `body.message` with `PublishPackageDraftsRequestSchema.shape.message` (the same member-of-the-declaration read the install door does with `ManifestSchema.shape.id` / `.version`). A note the member refuses is answered with `deps.error(text, 400)`, the envelope the install door's schema refusals already use (status 400 derives `VALIDATION_ERROR`; no code is minted). The text names the path: `Invalid publish-drafts body — message: Invalid input: expected string, received number. Nothing was published: …`. The forwarded note is now the parsed value.

**What stays exactly as it was**, by measurement:

- `backfill` is not judged at the door. Parsing the whole body here would refuse a bad `backfill` a second time with a different sentence and without the protocol's `issues[]`, so the protocol's own shape judgement stays the one refusal (same status, code, headline and `issues[]`; the existing real-protocol case in the conformance suite still passes with `publishPackageDrafts` called once).
- Unknown keys are not read: `{ actor: 'x', message: 'n' }` answers 200 and records the caller (SDK's deprecated `opts.actor`).
- A body that is not an object (or absent) has no `message` and publishes with the default note, as before. Only the `message` member narrows.
- ⛔ No `actor` handling changed (#28414 is closed; the card's Not-here line).

**Pins and prose flipped.**

- `packages-publish-drafts-request-conformance.test.ts`: the known-divergence case ("dropped by the door, not refused") becomes a refusal case over `{message: 42}`, `{message: {}}`, `{message: []}`, `{message: null}` and `{actor: 'x', message: 7}`: 400, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, headline names `message`, `publishPackageDrafts` and the app re-save never called. Its header's `message` bullet and the "does not claim the door parses the body" sentence are updated.
- `packages-publish-drafts-change-note.integration.test.ts` (real door + real protocol + ObjectQL + on-disk SQLite): `42`, `{}`, `[]` are each refused 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`; no `publish` history row and no package commit exist afterwards; the same draft then publishes with a string note and that row carries it.
- `route-ledger.ts`: the publish-drafts row note now says `message` is parsed with the schema's member and a non-string is refused 400.
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`: the `PublishPackageDraftsRequestSchema` docblock said "`message` — forwarded only when it is a string"; this diff makes that false, so it now says the door refuses a note the member refuses. JSDoc only: no `describe`, key or type moves, so the generated reference and the authorable surface do not move.
- The changeset carries a sentence superseding "Nothing changes on the wire" in the pending `28406-publish-drafts-request-schema.md` changeset (not edited: it is not this PR's).

## Tests

- **Red first** (the two new cases written and run against the unchanged base door, before the fix was written): both new cases red with `{"message":42}: expected 200 to be 400`; 11 other cases green.
- **Green** at the fix: the two files 13/13.
- **Ablation** (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `if (!declaredMessage.success) {` → `if (false && !declaredMessage.success) {`, which restores the string-only forward since a failed parse forwards no `data`): anchor 1 → 0, blob `ba0e3795ad83` → `5906236be414`; both refusal cases red, 11 controls (string note, no body, `actor` stripped, undeclared members, bad `backfill` real-protocol refusal) green; restore blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The runtime tests import the door from `src/`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 498 passed (498), Tests 8085 passed | 19 skipped (8104).

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-② arm.** The order and the claim expected `yes (narrowing)`. `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` reads `yes (narrowing)` as "widens one surface and narrows another"; this diff widens nothing, so the measured line is `no (narrowing)`, with the `**BREAKING**` banner and the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker in the changeset.
- **File surface beyond the claim.** `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` (the docblock sentence this diff made false) and an `@objectstack/spec` patch line in the changeset. The claim's file surface did not list them; the seat may amend it.
- **Placement.** The refusal sits after the 404 and the 501 capability probe, beside the protocol's backfill judgement, so both body-member refusals answer at one point of the door's order (the install door orders its body legs the same way relative to its id gate).

## Verification

All readings on head `af581fe0` (the only commit; nothing landed after the union ran).

- **Derived gate families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 84 families, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 84 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 84 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Two first reads were container prerequisites, re-read after meeting them: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3 → `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876…` → exit 0 (48 cases pass); `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 → full `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (116/116 tasks) → exit 0.
- **Hand gates:** `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` exit 0; `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0; `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the five touched source files exit 0 (neither `@objectstack/runtime` nor `@objectstack/spec` has a `lint` script; the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's).
- **Full dogfood** (owed by the `!` and the `(narrowing)` arm): after the full build, under the lock, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` → Test Files 363 passed | 3 skipped (366), Tests 2932 passed | 28 skipped (2960); no failure.
- **CI** families (Test Core, lint farm, type-check lanes) are read off this PR's check-runs by the seat.
